kitDescription: D is a Wind SMG Attacker whose sustained damage is propped up by two Elemental Advantage Attack Damage buffs that only pay out when she fights an Iron boss: a 91.09% self-buff for the first 15 seconds of the battle, and a 46.93% self-buff for 15 seconds each time the team enters Full Burst. At battle start she instantly fills 98.56% of the team's burst gauge (once per battle) and grants the whole team Stun immunity for 36.95 seconds. Her burst is a 426.24% hit against all enemies, plus a 42.38% Damage-to-Parts buff for all Attacker allies for 15 seconds. If she is still holding her own Stun immunity when she casts burst, that Full Burst lasts 5.04 seconds longer — with her 40-second burst cooldown that effectively means only her first cast of the fight qualifies. She also has self-only lifesteal while her Full Burst-entry buffs are running, with a stronger one-time version on its first activation.

redAssertions: burst block 3: 'raises TEAM output, not just d's' — expected sumDmg(base) > sumDmg(noFbExtend); measured 1,034,657,732 < 1,077,967,867. Classified RECON_ERROR (blind-side proxy failure): the proxy assumes FB uptime is monotonic in team damage on an infinite horizon; at the fixed 180s scope the +5.04s on FB#1 extends the gauge lock, delays every later chain, and the final cycle is clipped by fight end. The extension itself is proven LIVE by the green inFbHits-monotonic assertion and the driver's exact 902-frame single-window pin, so this is not an encoding divergence.

verdictRationale: All 9 kit lines are accounted for: 7 FAITHFUL with correct bucket placement (both Elemental Advantage lines in the measured advantage-gated element bucket, proven inert vs Fire and live vs Iron), correct trigger identities (fullBurstEnter vs burstCast genuinely diverge in this fixture and the driver keyed each correctly), and correct one-shot/timed semantics; the 2 self-lifesteal lines are DOCUMENTED_GAPs converged on by all three blind agents with the verbatim record pinned by test. The kit's crux — the stun-immunity-gated Full Burst extension — is where the driver beat the blind: S6 declared the gate inexpressible and shipped an ungated extension it self-flagged as its largest risk, while S5 independently derived from prose that only the first cast should extend; the driver's resource-window gate (seed at frame 0, decrement at 36.95s, resourceGate on the burst block) reproduces exactly that, with measured cast frames (110 inside, 2362+ outside) and window lengths (one 902-frame FB, all others 600) corroborating. S6's overwrite-vs-stack worry was also measured away (mult.elem 2.4802 = additive stacking). The single S5 RED is a blind-side RECON_ERROR: its sumDmg proxy assumes extension monotonically raises team damage, but at the fixed 180s horizon the longer FB#1 gauge lock delays later chains and clips the final cycle — the extension's liveness is separately proven green, so no encoding change follows. Discrimination holds via the driver's counterfactual suite (generic-stat, all-ally, permanent-window, ungated-extension, no-seed all asserted RED-vs-shipped). Residual same-model risks for the owner to spot-check: the ⚑2 window-vs-first-cast semantics (verify in-game that d's second burst does not extend Full Burst), the ⚑1 SMG cadence/reload tuple against a d focus video, and the ⚑4 passive-as-stage-appear reading should multi-boss scope ever arrive. Nothing must change for GO.
